facts.fact: The sanctuary is located on the hill of Sameiro, at Avenida de Nossa Senhora do Sameiro in Braga. Its Neoclassical basilica is arranged on a Latin-cross plan, with a dome and two towers; the grounds include gardens and open spaces.
facts.location: Main description, third paragraph and address.

facts.fact: The site developed from the nineteenth-century Marian initiative of priest Martinho António Pereira da Silva. The guide distinguishes this sanctuary from the separate Bom Jesus do Monte complex.
